tiers.name: Sequential Dual Forward Passes (`forward(cond)` Then `forward(uncond)`) + Separate Logit Copy
tiers.note: Reads 140GB of 70B model weights from HBM twice per token step and materializes two [B, 152K] logits tensors -> 42.5ms TPOT!

tiers.name: Submit `Cond` & `Uncond` as Two Independent Requests in Scheduler (Preemption Desync Risk)
tiers.note: If KV pressure preempts the Uncond request while Cond stays running, the sampler blocks waiting for its pair -> scheduler deadlock!

tiers.name: Atomic Paired `[2B]` Lockstep Batching + Unfused PyTorch `(1+w)*L_c - w*L_u` Logit Math
tiers.note: Reads model weights only once per step via [2B] batching and shares system prefix KV, but unfused 152K-vocab logit math adds 2.3ms overhead.

tiers.name: Atomic Paired `SequenceGroup` + Shared Prefix/Suffix KV + Fused Triton CFG-Plausibility Sampler
tiers.note: Co-schedules Cond/Uncond atomically, shares common prefix blocks, and fuses (1+a)*L_c - a*L_u + plausibility mask in SRAM -> 1.94x throughput!
